lines.zh: 我在红树林的根之间挤过去，鳞刮着树皮。
lines.en: I squeeze between mangrove roots, my scales scraping the bark.

lines.zh: 泥水很浅，我半个身子露在外面。
lines.en: The muddy water is shallow; half of me shows above it.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为我这一身板甲太重了。
lines.en: I move slowly because this armor of mine is heavy.

lines.zh: 我用鳍撑着泥地往前挪，一步一个坑。
lines.en: I haul myself along the mud with my fins, one pit per step.

lines.zh: 红树的影子落在水上，我沿着影子走。
lines.en: Mangrove shadows fall on the water, and I walk along them.

lines.zh: 我撞开一层浮萍，露出下面褐色的水。
lines.en: I push through a layer of duckweed and reveal the brown water below.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过泥面，带起一串泡泡。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the mud and raises a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 这一带的根我全认得，哪根会绊我我也知道。
lines.en: I know every root here, including the ones that trip me.

lines.zh: 我往前走的时候，泥会自己合上我的脚印。
lines.en: As I go, the mud closes over my tracks itself.

lines.zh: 我从水里探出头，吸一口又沉下去。
lines.en: I lift my head, take a breath, and sink again.

lines.zh: 我沿着水道走，那是最省力的一条路。
lines.en: I follow the channel, the least tiring route.

lines.zh: 别嫌我慢，我从泥里走来就是这个速度。
lines.en: Do not call me slow; this is the pace mud gives me.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥里，只把眼睛和鼻孔露出来。
lines.en: I lie in the mud with only my eyes and nostrils showing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，泥水就慢慢把我盖住。
lines.en: I hold still, and the muddy water slowly covers me.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴吸了一口空气，这里又湿又闷。
lines.en: I gape for air; it is damp and heavy here.

lines.zh: 我的鳞像一层旧盔甲，边角都磨圆了。
lines.en: My scales are like old armor with every corner worn round.

lines.zh: 红树的根泡在水里，泡出一股酸味。
lines.en: Mangrove roots soak in the water and sour it.

lines.zh: 我从泥里翻出一只螺，嚼了两下就咽了。
lines.en: I turn up a snail in the mud and swallow it after two chews.

lines.zh: 我的体型很壮，可我不太爱动。
lines.en: I am stoutly built, but I do not care to move much.

lines.zh: 水面上有虫，我抬头就能吃到。
lines.en: Insects sit on the surface; I only have to lift my head.

lines.zh: 沼泽很安静，只有气泡破掉的声音。
lines.en: The swamp is quiet except for bubbles popping.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去一点，让光晒到我的背。
lines.en: I turn slightly so the light reaches my back.

lines.zh: 我这一身厚皮，蚊虫叮不进去。
lines.en: This thick hide of mine keeps the insects out.

lines.zh: 泥里有味道，我慢慢分辨是哪一种。
lines.en: There is a taste in the mud, and I slowly sort out which.

lines.zh: 一片叶子落在我头上，我懒得甩掉。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my head; I cannot be bothered to shake it.

lines.zh: 我半沉在水里，这样最舒服。
lines.en: Half-submerged is the most comfortable way to be.

lines.zh: 红树的根把我围在中间。
lines.en: The mangrove roots fence me in.

lines.zh: 有只青蛙蹲在我背上，我不赶它。
lines.en: A frog sits on my back; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 水退了一点，泥露出来。
lines.en: The water drops and mud shows.

lines.zh: 我等一只虫子落下来。
lines.en: I wait for a bug to land.

lines.zh: 你走进沼泽，泥水没到你的小腿。
lines.en: You enter the swamp, mud to your calves.

lines.zh: 你在找我，而我就趴在你脚边的泥里。
lines.en: You are looking for me, and I am in the mud at your feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，泥从我的眼皮上滑下去。
lines.en: I lift my eyes, and mud slides off my lids.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住光，我只好抬头看看是谁。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks the light, so I look up to see who it is.

lines.zh: 你踩在树根上，我在下面看着你的靴子。
lines.en: You step on a root, and I watch your boots from below.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，这身皮厚得能顶住你的刀。
lines.en: I am not afraid; this hide can take your blade.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水面上多了一张倒影。
lines.en: You crouch, and another face appears on the water.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上那种干土的味道。
lines.en: I know that dry earth smell you carry.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，我们比谁更有耐心。
lines.en: Neither of us moves; we are measuring patience.

lines.zh: 你伸手进水，我看见了，只是没走。
lines.en: You reach into the water; I see it and simply do not leave.

lines.zh: 我的下巴搁在泥上，抬眼看你有一点费劲。
lines.en: My chin rests on mud, so looking up at you takes effort.

lines.zh: 你在这片沼泽里显得太干净了。
lines.en: You look much too clean for this swamp.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍在我的鳞上，只留下一道白印。
lines.en: Your blade hits my scales and leaves only a white mark.

lines.zh: 这一下砍进了缝里，我才真的疼。
lines.en: That one found a gap between scales, and that truly hurt.

lines.zh: 我往泥里退，泥能替我挡一半。
lines.en: I retreat into the mud; it will take half the blow.

lines.zh: 我流血很慢，泥水把红色压住了。
lines.en: I bleed slowly, and the muddy water swallows the red.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的鳍条，我游起来歪了。
lines.en: You break a fin ray, and now I swim lopsided.

lines.zh: 我疼得把身体绷紧，鳞都立起来了。
lines.en: Pain tenses my body until the scales stand up.

lines.zh: 我没什么可掉的，你打的是一身肉。
lines.en: I have no loot to drop; you are hitting meat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头，看看是谁砍的。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly to see who cut me.

lines.zh: 这一下不致命，可我得歇很久。
lines.en: It is not fatal, but I will need a long rest.

lines.zh: 你要是再来一下，我就撞回去。
lines.en: One more blow and I will ram you back.

lines.zh: 你手里那点吃的，味道盖过了泥。
lines.en: The food in your hand smells stronger than the mud.

lines.zh: 我从泥里挪出来，露出半个身子。
lines.en: I shift out of the mud, half of me exposed.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，等你自己把东西递过来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and wait for you to hand it over.

lines.zh: 我吃得慢，嚼东西也慢，你别催。
lines.en: I eat slowly and chew slowly; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在树根上，我就在那儿等你走开。
lines.en: You set the food on a root, and I wait there until you leave.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是鱼，不是虫，这很少见。
lines.en: I smell fish, not insects, which is rare here.

lines.zh: 这一口够我撑过整个下午。
lines.en: This mouthful will carry me through the whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 我挪近了一点，泥里留下很深的印子。
lines.en: I shift closer, leaving deep prints in the mud.

lines.zh: 我不抢，沼泽里的东西从来不用抢。
lines.en: I do not snatch; nothing in a swamp needs snatching.

lines.zh: 你喂完再退，剩下的我会连泥一起吃。
lines.en: Step back after feeding; I will eat the rest, mud and all.

lines.zh: 你踩到我背上，我像一块石头一样没动。
lines.en: You step on my back, and I do not shift, like a stone.

lines.zh: 我撞你的腿，力道不大，但很沉。
lines.en: I bump your leg, not hard, but heavy.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进泥里，正好卡在我旁边。
lines.en: Your boot sinks into the mud right beside me.

lines.zh: 我被你挤了一下，身上的泥掉了一层。
lines.en: One shove from you knocks a layer of mud off me.

lines.zh: 我这一身分量，撞上来是推得动的。
lines.en: With this much weight, I can actually push you.

lines.zh: 水里看不清，你差点踩到我的头。
lines.en: The water hides things; you nearly stepped on my head.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，泥水立刻涌进我们之间的缝。
lines.en: I flinch, and muddy water rushes into the gap between us.

lines.zh: 你后退时踢到树根，我在这边听着。
lines.en: You kick a root as you retreat, and I listen from here.

lines.zh: 我不生气，沼泽里本来就要互相挤。
lines.en: I am not angry; in a swamp, everyone crowds everyone.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，我们身上都多了一层泥。
lines.en: Afterward we both wear an extra layer of mud.

lines.zh: 我们两只在树根间慢慢并排，谁也不急。
lines.en: The two of us ease along the roots side by side, unhurried.

lines.zh: 她的背比我的窄一圈，颜色也深一点。
lines.en: Her back is a shade narrower and darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我用吻端碰她的侧腹，泥水都晃了。
lines.en: I touch her flank with my snout, and the muddy water sways.

lines.zh: 我们找了一处根最密的水洼，那里最安全。
lines.en: We find a pool where the roots grow thickest, the safest spot.

lines.zh: 她先趴下，我才跟着趴在她旁边。
lines.en: She lies down first, and I settle beside her.

lines.zh: 我们一群本来最多两只，正好是我们。
lines.en: Our groups never exceed two, and we are exactly two.

lines.zh: 我把泥推到她身上，这是我表达的方式。
lines.en: I push mud onto her; that is how I say it.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸很慢，我跟着她的节奏。
lines.en: Her breathing is slow, and I match its rhythm.

lines.zh: 水洼很小，我们挤在一起也不算挤。
lines.en: The pool is small, and pressed together we still fit.

lines.zh: 她走后，那块泥还留着她的形状。
lines.en: After she leaves, the mud still holds her shape.

lines.zh: 有东西掉进沼泽，我听见那声闷响。
lines.en: Something drops into the swamp, and I hear the dull splash.

lines.zh: 我把那枚铁片从泥里拱出来，又埋回去。
lines.en: I root an iron scrap out of the mud and bury it again.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞着东西，说话含糊。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so my words come out muddled.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，可以磨我的牙。
lines.en: This bone is good; it will wear down my teeth.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沉进泥里，只剩一个角露着。
lines.en: What you dropped sinks into mud with one corner showing.

lines.zh: 我用背把它顶到根下，那里没人会翻。
lines.en: I nudge it under a root with my back, where no one digs.

lines.zh: 我含着一颗石子，凉得让我的嘴舒服。
lines.en: I hold a pebble whose coolness soothes my mouth.

lines.zh: 泥里的东西多半是烂的，我也照样收着。
lines.en: Most things in the mud are rotten, and I keep them anyway.

lines.zh: 我挪过去的时候，把捡的东西压进了泥。
lines.en: As I shift over, I press what I found into the mud.

lines.zh: 捡东西对我没什么用，我只是顺手。
lines.en: Collecting does me no good; it just happens.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我常趴的那块泥，我记住了。
lines.en: You trampled the mud I always lie in, and I remember.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抬起头，正对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head from the mud, aimed straight at you.

lines.zh: 我盯上你，不是因为饿，是因为你太吵。
lines.en: I have marked you not out of hunger but because you are loud.

lines.zh: 这片水洼是我的，树根也是我的。
lines.en: This pool is mine, and so are the roots.

lines.zh: 我不追远，但你在我这片里就得挨一下。
lines.en: I do not chase far, but in my patch you get one blow.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我就停下，我只守到水边。
lines.en: You back onto land, and I stop; I guard only to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，泥在我身下裂开。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and the mud cracks beneath me.

lines.zh: 目标离我很近，我不需要游过去。
lines.en: The target is close; I need not swim anywhere.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，准备用整个身体撞。
lines.en: I lower my head, preparing to ram with my whole body.

lines.zh: 你最好别在我这片水洼里久留。
lines.en: You had better not linger in my pool.

lines.zh: 我一点点挪近，泥水被我推得往前涌。
lines.en: I shuffle closer, pushing the muddy water ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在上面，身体还藏在泥里。
lines.en: My eyes are up top while my body stays buried.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，泥就响一声。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, the mud answers with a sound.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，我的冲刺只有一次。
lines.en: I am judging distance; I get only one lunge.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开了，这在沼泽里算警告。
lines.en: I open my mouth, which counts as a warning here.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷得深，跑不快，我知道。
lines.en: Your boots sink deep and you cannot run; I know.

lines.zh: 我往上浮了一点，背脊露了出来。
lines.en: I rise a little and my ridged back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 我不着急，泥里的东西从来跑不掉。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; nothing in mud ever gets away.

lines.zh: 你转身时溅起的水，落在我脸上。
lines.en: The water you kick up on turning lands on my face.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就会把整个身体甩过去。
lines.en: One step closer and I will throw my whole body at you.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体撞你，声音像木头撞木头。
lines.en: I ram you with everything, a sound like wood on wood.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的小腿，牙齿不算尖，可劲很大。
lines.en: I bite your calf; my teeth are not sharp, but my jaw is strong.

lines.zh: 这一下把你撞得坐进了泥里。
lines.en: The blow sits you down in the mud.

lines.zh: 我的鳞边刮过你，留下一道红痕。
lines.en: My scale edges rake you and leave a red line.

lines.zh: 我不松口，直到泥水灌进你的靴子。
lines.en: I hold on until muddy water fills your boots.

lines.zh: 打完我又趴回泥里，像什么都没发生。
lines.en: Afterward I lie back in the mud as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，我撞你一下，很公平。
lines.en: You cut me once, I ram you once; that is fair.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉很沉，撞上来是实打实的。
lines.en: All this bulk is heavy, and the impact is real.

lines.zh: 我不追击，你离开水我就停。
lines.en: I do not pursue; once you leave the water, I stop.

lines.zh: 你被我顶开半米，水花溅到树根上。
lines.en: I shove you half a block back, splashing the roots.

lines.zh: 我在红树林的浅水里出现，泥一下涌进鳃。
lines.en: I appear in the mangrove shallows, and mud floods my gills.

lines.zh: 出生时我的鳞还是软的，一天后就硬了。
lines.en: At birth my scales are soft; within a day they harden.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是浮上去吸一口气。
lines.en: My first act is rising to take a breath.

lines.zh: 树根在我头顶交错，像一张盖子。
lines.en: Roots interlace above my head like a lid.

lines.zh: 我身边还有一只同类，我们各占一块泥。
lines.en: One kin is beside me, and we claim a patch of mud each.

lines.zh: 这里的水又浅又暖，正合我的身体。
lines.en: The water here is shallow and warm, right for my build.

lines.zh: 我从泥里钻出来的时候，身上挂着水草。
lines.en: When I emerge from the mud, weed hangs off me.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸就咳出了一口泥水。
lines.en: My first breath coughs out a mouthful of muddy water.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽的声音很杂，虫、水、还有风。
lines.en: This swamp is full of sounds: insects, water, wind.

lines.zh: 我落在树根间，那儿最不容易被冲走。
lines.en: I land between roots, the spot least likely to wash away.

lines.zh: 我一出生就很沉，浮起来要费点劲。
lines.en: I am born heavy, and rising takes some effort.

lines.zh: 我决定就在这片根下待着，不往深处去。
lines.en: I decide to stay under these roots and go no deeper.

lines.zh: 沼泽着火了，我沉到泥底，只留鼻孔在上面。
lines.en: The swamp is on fire; I sink to the mud bed, nostrils only.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，重重砸在根上。
lines.en: I am flung ashore and crash down on a root.

lines.zh: 我在干地上张着嘴，鳃里全是灰。
lines.en: On dry ground I gape, and my gills fill with dust.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的泥落下来，把我整个埋住。
lines.en: Blast-thrown mud rains down and buries me whole.

lines.zh: 箭插在我的鳞缝里，晃着，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my scales, wobbling, stuck fast.

lines.zh: 药水雾落进沼泽，我嘴里发苦。
lines.en: Potion mist settles on the swamp and my mouth turns bitter.

lines.zh: 泥里翻不出东西，我的肚子贴着脊背。
lines.en: The mud yields nothing, and my belly presses to my spine.

lines.zh: 雷劈中红树，亮光透过水照到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning strikes a mangrove, and the flash reaches me through the water.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，我第一次不知道往哪儿趴。
lines.en: No mud in the void; for once I do not know where to lie.
